caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate metal hinge rendered in tones of grey, brown, and gold. The hinge is symmetrical and features intricate, decorative scrollwork on both sides, with a fuller, more compact floral design at the left end surrounding a circular flower-like motif. The right side of the hinge is elongated and tapers towards the end, framed by multiple curled and pointed extensions. There are three visible holes along the hinge’s flat surface, presumably for screws or fasteners. The hinge has a barrel in the middle for movement. In the top left and bottom right corners are two smaller linear sketches in black, showing side and plan views of the same hinge, including measurements and structural details. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Hinge
